title: Validation: allow implicit Agent provider when model is dict name=provider/model
description: RegistryBuilder.validate currently allows missing Agent.provider when Agent.model is a string in provider/model or provider:model form, but it still errors when Agent.model is a dict (model settings) with name="openai/gpt-4o-mini". This blocks the common pattern Agent { model = { name=..., temperature=... } } with provider omitted.\n\nFix: Extend agent validation to inspect dict model.name for a provider prefix and treat it as implicit provider.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria: - Agent { model={name="openai/gpt-4o-mini"} } validates without provider/default_provider\n- Unit tests cover dict + string cases
custom.beads_close_reason: Registry validation now treats model={name="openai/..."} as implicit provider; added unit test
